entities.name: MdtK (UniProt B7US04)
observations: Exact sequence match to reviewed Escherichia coli MdtK; 457 aa, 49.45 kDa, predicted pI 9.63.
Annotated as a probable Na+/drug antiporter and multidrug efflux pump at the bacterial inner membrane.
Sequence contains two MatE domains (PF01554), at residues 17–177 and 244–405.
